SuperAdmin.title: SuperAdmin
SuperAdmin.description: Represents a super administrator user in the AuthStation application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SuperAdmin entity.

email.description: Email address of the super administrator.

departmentName.description: The name of the super administrator's department.

Organization.title: Organization
Organization.description: Represents a single organization with its own login credentials.

id.description: Unique Firebase Auth UID for the organization's login.

email.description: The primary login email for the organization.

createdAt.description: The ISO timestamp of when the organization was created.

superAdminId.description: The ID of the SuperAdmin who created this organization.

Department.title: Department
Department.description: Represents a department within an organization. It does not have its own login credentials.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Department entity.

email.description: The login email of the parent organization.

organizationName.description: The name of the parent organization.

floor.description: The floor the department is on.

building.description: The building the department is in.

location.description: The general location of the department.

superAdminId.description: Reference to the SuperAdmin who created this.

organizationId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the parent organization this department belongs to.

Device.title: Device
Device.description: Represents an IoT device registered to a department within an organization.

id.description: Unique identifier for the IoT device.

name.description: A user-friendly name for the device (e.g., 'Living Room Sensor').

location.description: The physical location of the device.

status.description: The current status of the device.

lastSeen.description: The ISO timestamp of when the device last reported its status.

departmentId.description: The ID of the department (Department document) this device is registered under.

type.description: The category or type of the device.

description.description: An optional description of the device's purpose.

Alert.title: Alert
Alert.description: Represents a system alert generated by an IoT device.

deviceId.description: The ID of the device that triggered the alert.

deviceName.description: The name of the device for easy identification.

departmentId.description: The ID of the department (Department document) this alert belongs to.

type.description: The type of event that triggered the alert (e.g., 'Device Offline', 'Anomalous Behaviour').

severity.description: The severity level of the alert.

status.description: The current lifecycle status of the alert.

createdAt.description: The ISO timestamp when the alert was created.

details.description: An optional detailed message about the alert.

firestore.reasoning: This Firestore data structure is designed to support the AuthStation application, focusing on secure authentication and access control for Super Admins and Organizations. The key change is the introduction of a single login per organization. The '/organizations/{orgId}' collection holds the primary record for each company, and its document ID is the Firebase Auth UID. The '/departments' collection now represents departments, with each document containing an 'organizationId' field that links it back to the parent organization's auth account. This avoids creating separate auth users for each department, simplifying user management while maintaining a clear, hierarchical data structure.
